TextView.android:text:
Q: How do I book a nanny?
A: Navigate to the booking screen from the main dashboard, select your dates, and confirm.

Q: How do I cancel a booking?
A: Go to your bookings list, tap the active booking, and select 'Cancel'.

Q: How do I update my profile?
A: Tap the profile icon in the menu to edit your details.

Q: Who do I contact for support?
A: Please email support@nannysystem.com for further assistance.
